title: Policy Matrix
description: Effective role x action authorization matrix derived from the policy bundle currently loaded by the gateway (SPEC-019 R-2). Read-only transparency surface; never a source of authority — enforcement stays with the policy engine.

version.description: The version field of the loaded policy bundle.

source.description: Where the loaded bundle came from: the configured policy path or the packaged default.

scope.description: platform-admin receives every role row (full); every other identity receives only its granted roles (own).

roles.description: The roles with rows in this response, sorted.

actions.description: The action catalog (bundle actions union protected route actions), sorted.

matrix.description: role -> action -> allow (true) or deny (false), evaluated with full policy semantics.
